title: A re-audit of pulmonary function laboratories in the West Midlands.
standard: not reported
finding: Significant inter-laboratory variability.
change: Recommendations to improve consistency and national and regional training workshops for laboratory staff.

detail.setting: 22 pulmonary function laboratories in the West Midlands

cycle1.result: Significant inter-laboratory variability.

detail.intervention: Recommendations to improve consistency and national and regional training workshops for laboratory staff.

cycle2.result: Most variables had a coefficient of variation under 5%; improvements for predicted FEV1, TLC, TLCO, FVC, FRC and RV and measured FEV1 and FVC.

detail.other_findings: Predicted values from hypothetical subjects still varied unacceptably due to computer algorithm inconsistency; variation increased for predicted KCO and actual RV.
